title: When the loop ends without a match, lo is the ceiling and hi is the floor
caption: Ceiling of key = 12 (the smallest value ≥ 12). The window is the range still in play, nums[lo .. hi].

frames.text: lo = 0, hi = 6, mid = 3: 10 < 12, so the ceiling is to the right. lo = mid + 1 = 4.
lo = 4, hi = 6, mid = 5: 20 > 12. 20 could be the ceiling, but something smaller may be too, so hi = mid − 1 = 4.
lo = mid = hi = 4: 15 > 12, so hi = mid − 1 = 3.
lo > hi, so the range is empty. lo = 4 points at the ceiling, 15. hi = 3 points at the floor, 10.
